## Projects

- [GitX](https://wujecdamian.dev/project/gitx): full-stack social platform for developers, recruiters and companies (PostgreSQL, Express, React, Node.js). [Live](https://gitx.wujecdamian.dev/) · [Code](https://github.com/WujecDamian/gitX)
- [AutoWydatki](https://wujecdamian.dev/project/autowydatki): car running-cost tracker with fuel/EV charging, services and reminders (React, Redux Toolkit, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Passport.js). [Live](https://autowydatki.wujecdamian.dev/) · [Code](https://github.com/WujecDamian/Autowydatki)
- [FireFocus AI](https://wujecdamian.dev/project/firefocus): Chrome extension that blocks off-topic pages during a focus session, using the Gemini API. [Live](https://firefocusai.com/)
- [Messages CRUD](https://wujecdamian.dev/project/wiadomosci): small full-stack CRUD app with validation, 44 tests, CI and deployment. [Live](https://wiadomosci.wujecdamian.dev) · [Code](https://github.com/WujecDamian/CRUD_wiadomosci)
- [Where's Waldo?](https://wujecdamian.dev/project/waldo): photo-tagging game with server-side timing and a leaderboard. [Live](https://wujec-wheres-waldo.netlify.app/) · [Code](https://github.com/WujecDamian/odin-Wheres-Waldo)
